about: FIXTURE LIST, not a copy of any real list. It stands in for the Phantom blocklist and the PhishDestroy list so the E-11 threshold can be tested. Every domain uses the reserved .example or .test top-level domains (RFC 2606), so none resolves. Under the owner's ruling 2a the lists are fixture lists only: the real Phantom and PhishDestroy lists are not bundled, and pulling in the Phantom blocklist is post-event H-05.
